And, whereas, copies of the said Gazette were made available to the public on 25th June, 2013; 3. And, whereas, objections and suggestions were received from the public on the said draft rules, have been duly considered by the Central Government; 4. Now, therefore, in exercise of powers conferred by Section 5 of the Explosives Act, 1884 (4 of 1884) the Central Government hereby makes the following rules, namely:- (1) These rules may be called the Explosives (Amendments) Rules, 2013. (2) They shall come into force on the date of their final publication in the Gazette of India. 5. In the Explosives Rules, 2008 in Schedule IV, in part 2, for words beginning with “A. Fees other than licence fees”…. and ending with …. “External Fire (Bonfire) Test 45,000”, the words and brackets “Fee shall be as stipulated vide Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion’s latest User Fee Notice (Explosives)” shall be substituted. [F. No. 22(36)/2010-Expls] ATUL CHATURVEDI, Jt. Secy. Note : The principal rules were published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary vide notification number GSR 907(E), dated the 29th December, 2008.
